hooks.command: [ "$(osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get name of first process whose frontmost is true' 2>/dev/null)" = 'wezterm-gui' ] || /opt/homebrew/bin/terminal-notifier -title 'Claude Code' -message 'Permission needed' -sound Glass -group claude

[ "$(osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get name of first process whose frontmost is true' 2>/dev/null)" = 'wezterm-gui' ] || /opt/homebrew/bin/terminal-notifier -title 'Claude Code' -message 'Input needed' -sound Glass -group claude

[ "$(osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get name of first process whose frontmost is true' 2>/dev/null)" = 'wezterm-gui' ] || /opt/homebrew/bin/terminal-notifier -title 'Claude Code' -message 'Finished' -sound Purr -group claude

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); r=$(echo "$input" | tr '\n' ' ' | jq -r '.context_window as $ctx | ($ctx.context_window_size // 200000) as $size | (($ctx.current_usage.input_tokens // 0) + ($ctx.current_usage.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) + ($ctx.current_usage.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) + ($ctx.current_usage.output_tokens // 0)) as $used | if $used > 0 then ((($size - $used) * 100 / $size) | floor | if . < 0 then 0 elif . > 100 then 100 else . end) else 100 end'); output=""; if [ -n "$r" ]; then if [ "$r" -gt 50 ]; then color="\033[32m"; elif [ "$r" -ge 20 ]; then color="\033[33m"; else color="\033[31m"; fi; filled=$((r / 10)); empty=$((10 - filled)); bar=""; i=0; while [ "$i" -lt "$filled" ]; do bar="${bar}█"; i=$((i + 1)); done; i=0; while [ "$i" -lt "$empty" ]; do bar="${bar}░"; i=$((i + 1)); done; output=$(printf "${color}${bar} ${r}%%\033[0m"); fi; jj_bookmark=$(jj log -r @ --no-graph -T 'bookmarks' 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$jj_bookmark" ]; then jj_bookmark=$(jj log -r 'ancestors(@) & bookmarks()' --limit 1 --no-graph -T 'bookmarks' 2>/dev/null); fi; if [ -n "$jj_bookmark" ]; then [ -n "$output" ] && output="$output │ "; output="${output}\033[36m${jj_bookmark}\033[0m"; fi; jj_desc=$(jj log -r @ --no-graph -T 'description.first_line()' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$jj_desc" ]; then jj_desc_trimmed=$(echo "$jj_desc" | cut -c1-72); [ -n "$output" ] && output="$output │ "; output="${output}${jj_desc_trimmed}"; fi; [ -n "$output" ] && echo "$output"
